detached_structure.evidence: Small structures sit to the south and southwest, but they are likely on neighboring lots or too ambiguous to attribute to the central lot.

signals.notes: The central house has a gray multi-gable roof that looks uniform and intact, and a driveway on the west side with one dark vehicle; dense mature trees cover the yard to the south and west, while the neighboring house to the east is mid-reroof with blue tarps.
